observations: Nikon DSLR camera body held in a hand.
A black silicone protective skin (EasyCover) is fitted over the body.
The rear LCD screen is off and appears dark.
The model name 'D7000' is visible on the bottom left of the LCD bezel in photo 0.
The button layout on the left of the screen consists of four buttons in a column (Menu, WB, Qual, ISO) plus two at the top (Playback, Trash).
A 'Lv' (Live View) switch and a multi-selector with a lock switch are visible on the right.
The image contains a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark with the name 'KAYODE OLUWASEYI'.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, the top LCD activating, and the shutter firing.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched, dirty, or damaged.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed and mirror locked up.

risks.risk: The shutter mechanism may be near the end of its rated life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count obtained from the EXIF data of a recent photo.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count (>100,000)

risks.risk: The silicone skin may be concealing cracks, heavy wear, or impact damage to the chassis.
risks.proof: Photos of the camera body from all angles with the protective skin removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged or cracked body

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the battery, charger, or a lens may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the camera with its battery, charger, and any included lenses.
risks.if_unproven: as body only, without battery or charger

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the front of the camera with the lens removed to show the sensor.
Photos of the camera body with the silicone skin removed.
Screenshot of the current shutter count.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The camera is identified as a Nikon D7000 based on the bezel text and button configuration. It is priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional body for parts due to the lack of proof of operation and the presence of a protective skin that may hide damage.
